title: SECURITY: Root node accepts fraudulent below-ROOT_RANK DIOs
description:
Location: rust/lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs lines 380-396 (process_dio)

Issue: For same-version DIOs, candidate_admissible() is not called, so the check candidate.rank < min_hop_rank_increase (line 103) that rejects parents advertising ranks below ROOT_RANK is bypassed.

A malicious node can send a same-version DIO with rank=100 (below ROOT_RANK=256). The rank check at line 370 (dio.rank >= self.rank) passes because 100 < 256. The candidate is inserted and select_parent() is called, which in release builds silently fails the role transition but still corrupts preferred_parent, rank, and potentially lowest_rank.

Attack scenario:
1. Root node at rank 256 receives DIO with rank=100, version=current, link_etx=1.0
2. Candidate passes validation (line 370 check fails: 100 >= 256 is false)
3. Parent is inserted (line 392)
4. select_parent() sets preferred_parent and corrupts root rank to 356
5. Role transition to Joined fails silently in release (debug_assert at line 474)

Impact: Root node state corruption; incorrect rank advertisement; potential routing instability.

Fix: Either:
1. Add explicit root guard at start of process_dio
2. Use candidate_admissible() validation for all DIOs, not just newer versions
3. Add rank bound check: if dio.rank < self.min_hop_rank_increase { return DioOutcome::Rejected; }
close_reason: Fixed: root guard at process_dio() entry already rejects all DIOs; added regression test root_rejects_below_root_rank_dio_attack
